references.text: God warns against oppressing widows and orphans, and shows his care for the vulnerable in society
Prohibition against perverting justice for the foreigner and orphan, or taking a widow's garment as collateral
Command to let the foreigner, orphan, and widow gather what is left at harvest
God is described as the father of the fatherless and defender of widows
The Lord protects foreigners and upholds widows and orphans
Prophetic command to do justice toward the foreigner, orphan, and widow
Warning against oppressing widows, orphans, foreigners, and the poor
Command to love the foreigner as yourself, because the Israelites themselves were foreigners in Egypt
Pure and undefiled religion involves caring for widows and orphans in their distress
